finding::nobody-reaches-your-pipeline-wi.note: discover() drops any find failing hasAnyContact, and the test is keyed on a real contact value: a bio page carrying channel "Website Form" and no address, number or handle is refused.

finding::a-search-with-no-location-given.note: The HOME BASE rule names no city, and still says outright that with no base given it applies no geography, invents no city, and does not fall back to any place named elsewhere in the prompt.

importing::spreadsheet-junk-does-not-bec.note: Blank rows, "TRUE"/"FALSE"/"N/A"/"x" cell artifacts, a prose note with no contact route, and a duplicate all fail to become contacts; the one real row does.

importing::accents-and-unusual-character.note: Display values survive intact, but the dedup key treats "Zoë Müller" and "Zoe Muller" as two different people (normNameKey drops non-ASCII rather than folding it), so the same person imported twice under two spellings lands twice.

importing::a-very-large-file-does-not-ha.note: 20,000 rows map to 20,000 contacts in 24ms, so the parse itself cannot be what hangs a big import.

importing::a-broken-or-wrong-file-fails-.note: Empty, unmapped, null-valued, project-less and non-sheet inputs all come back as an empty list rather than throwing.

importing::imported-personal-contacts-st.note: Only role inboxes on company domains cross into the shared index; personal freemail addresses and bare handles are held back, and the publish path filters on it.

importing::imported-rows-link-back-to-th.note: A row stamped 42 becomes a contact whose link opens that sheet at gid=7, cell A42.

feel::animation-respects-the-reduce-moti.note: 6 of 6 animated classes in globals.css have a reduced-motion override. Separately, Tailwind's own utilities are used in the app and none of them are covered, because the overrides are written one class at a time in globals.css: animate-spin (4), animate-pulse (7), animate-ping (1). One blanket rule — animation and transition off under prefers-reduced-motion — would cover these and every future one.
